adjudication.rationale: In `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx`, the list of email inputs is rendered with `value.map((field, index) => <li key={index}> ...)` and items can be removed via `updatedValue.splice(index, 1)`. Using the array index as the React key in a list where elements are deleted/inserted can cause React to reuse component instances for different rows, which can preserve per-row component/DOM state (e.g., focus, validation state inside `EmailField`) across removals. The diff shows this dynamic splice behavior, but because the input is controlled (`value={field}`), the “stale/uncontrolled input values” part isn’t strictly provable from the diff alone.
